ini.droh.log: Standoff with {name}: the situation remains on the brink of war (conflict {konflikt} of 100).
ini.droh.uebergeben: Handed over to the conflict process: tension with this country rises to the level of a standoff; the country's file is under Foreign Affairs.
ini.droh.naechstePruefung: The conflict episode takes up the situation at the next monthly review, as long as the conflict stays above its threshold; there is no automatic war.
ini.paket.laufzeit: Term: {jahre, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}.
ini.fordert.rot_fallback: {wer} sees one of its red lines touched.
ini.fordert.grund_rot: {rot} {wer} now wants a visible sign that Türkiye respects that line{mit, select, ja { — specifically: “{klausel}”} other {}}.
ini.fordert.ausstrahlung_fallback: A treaty between Türkiye and a third country affects this country.
ini.fordert.grund_ausstrahlung: {anlass} {wer} demands clarity{mit, select, ja { and a concession: “{klausel}”} other {}}.
ini.fordert.grund_anliegen: {wer} sends word that patience is running out: {anliegen}{mit, select, ja { At the negotiating table this would mean: “{klausel}”. {wert}} other {}}
ini.fordert.lage: Relations stand at trust {vertrauen} and conflict {konflikt}. A response is expected.{drohung, select, ja { Between the lines there is a hint that alternatives to good relations exist.} other {}}
ini.fordert.warum: Other states have their own interests and their own deadlines. Ignore their concerns and they come back as demands — with a price on either answer.
ini.fordert.opt.gespraech.ergebnis: {wer} accepts the offer of talks but still waits for action.
ini.fordert.opt.zusagen.folge: {wer} receives a promise that will be called in within eight months.
ini.fordert.opt.zusagen.ergebnis: The government promises {wer} to address the concern.
ini.fordert.opt.zurueckweisen.ergebnis: The government rejects the demand from {wer}.
ini.fordert.opt.erfuellen: Meet the demand (treaty for {jahre, plural, one {# year} other {# years}})
ini.fordert.opt.erfuellen.folge: {wer} gets “{klausel}” as a treaty; relations ease, but the treaty binds and is reviewed every year.
ini.fordert.opt.erfuellen.unmoeglich: The demand can no longer be met: {grund}
ini.fordert.opt.gegenangebot: Counter-offer: concession in exchange for something in return
ini.fordert.opt.gegenangebot.folge_tausc: Türkiye gives “{gibt}” and asks for “{will}”; if {land} does not agree, the negotiation was in vain.
ini.fordert.opt.gegenangebot.folge_kurz: the same clause, but binding for only two years; if {land} does not agree, the negotiation was in vain.
ini.fordert.opt.gegenangebot.nichts: There is nothing to negotiate against.
ini.fordert.opt.gegenangebot.nein: {wer} insists on the full demand and rejects the exchange. The negotiating table remains open.
ini.fordert.opt.ablehnen.folge: applause at home, but relations cool and the dispute grows.
ini.fordert.opt.ablehnen.ergebnis: The government declines the demand from {wer}.
ini.fordert.standard: {wer} takes the silence as an answer.
ini.angebot.zeile_ausstrahlung: {anlass} {wer} wants to seize the moment and puts a package on the table.
ini.angebot.zeile: {wer} puts a package on the table.
ini.angebot.lage: Relations are good (trust {vertrauen}); now is the time to make something of it. The options show what the package would do at home.
ini.angebot.warum: Trust is capital that can only be cashed in when an offer comes. Never cash it in, and it was built up for nothing. But a treaty binds both sides and is reviewed every year.
ini.angebot.unmoeglich: The package is no longer possible: {grund}
ini.angebot.opt.annehmen: Accept: {jahre, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}
ini.angebot.opt.annehmen.folge_zeilen: at home: {zeilen}; a treaty binds and is reviewed every year.
ini.angebot.opt.annehmen.folge: a treaty binds and is reviewed every year.
ini.angebot.opt.verhandeln: Negotiate: commit for only two years
ini.angebot.opt.verhandeln.folge: weaker lasting effects, but less commitment.
ini.angebot.opt.verhandeln.ergebnis: Türkiye and {land} conclude a two-year treaty.
ini.angebot.opt.ablehnen.ergebnis: Türkiye politely declines the proposal from {wer}.
ini.verl.text: The treaty with {name} ({vertrag}) expires in about {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}. {wer} approaches Türkiye early and offers an extension{mit, select, ja { — in return for the long commitment it expects a small extra: “{zugabe}”} other {}}.
ini.verl.bilanz: {gehalten, select, ja {The treaty has been honoured so far; that counts in favour of an extension.} other {There have been violations; an extension is therefore in doubt.}} Trust stands at {vertrauen}.
ini.verl.warum: Expiring treaties do not stop mattering just because they are forgotten: the lasting effects end, and the other country wonders whether you meant it. Whoever comes early acts out of interest, not friendliness.
ini.verl.opt.zugabe: Extend with an extra: five years plus “{zugabe}”
ini.verl.opt.zugabe.folge: the lasting effects continue for five years; the extra is a small two-year additional protocol.
ini.verl.opt.zugabe.ja: {r} As an extra, both sides sign an additional protocol: “{zugabe}”.
ini.verl.opt.zugabe.nein: {r} The extra is dropped; it is no longer possible.
ini.verl.opt.fuenf.folge: the lasting effects continue, and so does the commitment.
ini.verl.opt.zwei.folge: shorter commitment without an extra; the effects continue.
ini.verl.opt.auslaufen.folge: the effects end with the treaty; the country remembers the reluctance.
ini.verl.standard: The offer from {wer} lapses; the treaty with {name} expires without an extension.
ini.prov.text: The long-running dispute with {name} is escalating from the other side: statements, manoeuvres, accusations — apparently the aim is to provoke Türkiye. The conflict stands at {konflikt} of 100.
ini.prov.warum: Provocations are invitations to make a mistake: whoever tolerates them loses face; whoever hits back fuels the dispute; whoever calls in mediators needs patience and some standing.
ini.prov.opt.dulden: Tolerate it and don't take the bait
ini.prov.opt.dulden.folge: no escalation, but a loss of face at home.
ini.prov.opt.dulden.ergebnis: The government stays silent on the accusations from {land}; at home, some read this as weakness.
ini.prov.opt.kontern: Hit back: sharp response and manoeuvres
ini.prov.opt.kontern.folge: a strong showing at home that fuels the dispute and costs money.
ini.prov.opt.kontern.ergebnis: Ankara responds sharply and deploys troops; tension with {name} rises.
ini.prov.opt.vermittlung.folge: third-party mediators are to calm the situation; if they fail, Türkiye looks weaker.
ini.prov.opt.vermittlung.ja: Mediators put the dispute on ice: tension with {name} eases.
ini.prov.opt.vermittlung.nein: {wer} rebuffs the mediators; the attempt looks like an admission.
ini.prov.standard: Without a response, the tone grows harsher.
ini.drohk.text: {wer} leaves patience and diplomacy behind: troop movements, sharp words, and a concrete demand on top{mit, select, ja { — “{klausel}”} other {}}. The conflict stands at {konflikt} of 100, just below the threshold at which a crisis can turn into war.
ini.drohk.warnung: The General Staff warns that any wrong answer could tip the situation; the foreign press speaks of the gravest crisis of this term.
ini.drohk.warum: On the brink of war, every answer has two prices: the immediate one for the relationship and the domestic one for the President's standing. Giving in calms and shames, standing firm honours and risks, mediation costs prestige and time.
ini.drohk.opt.nachgeben.folge: the crisis eases immediately, but yielding under threat costs prestige abroad and votes in the nationalist camp.
ini.drohk.opt.nachgeben.unmoeglich: The concession can no longer be made: {grund}
ini.drohk.opt.nachgeben.ergebnis: Türkiye yields to the show of force{mit, select, ja { and grants “{klausel}” by treaty} other {}}; the situation calms, but giving in under pressure will be remembered.
ini.drohk.opt.standhalten.folge: show resolve: the country rallies, but the show of force remains — and the danger of war draws closer.
ini.drohk.opt.standhalten.ergebnis: Ankara rejects the demand from {wer} and stands firm at the threshold.
ini.drohk.opt.vermittlung.folge: expensive and uncertain: if it succeeds, the situation eases noticeably; if it fails, the show of force grows.
ini.drohk.opt.vermittlung.ja: Mediators achieve de-escalation: {wer} withdraws the show of force.
ini.drohk.opt.vermittlung.nein: Mediation fails; {wer} reads the attempt as weakness and steps up the show of force.
ini.drohk.standard: Without a response, {wer} keeps up the show of force; the crisis “Danger of war” bears the consequences.
